name: app/toolbar
title: Toolbar
summary: The row above a list: a full-width search box (a GET form) joined to a button group of filters or menus.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the search box ("Search agents").

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Hint in the empty box; defaults to `label`.

props.name: action
props.description: Form action; the current page when omitted.

props.name: keep
props.description: Other parameters carried through as hidden inputs (a range, a sort).

props.name: id
props.description: Prefix for the input id; unique per page.

slots.name: filters
slots.description: The button group on the right.

behaviour: Search is a role="search" GET form: Enter submits, the result is a URL.
A visually hidden submit button appears on focus for keyboard users.

keyboard: Tab reaches a submit button that becomes visible on focus.
focus: The box shows the focus ring through its row.
aria: The box has a visually hidden <label>.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: Below sm the button group wraps under the box; from sm they are one bordered row with a hairline between.
contract:
contract
  slot is "toolbar"
  when default shows button "Last 7 days"
  when bare slot is "toolbar"
end

checks.say: No filters slot, no button group.
